mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ( SELECT sr.company_id FROM salary_records sr JOIN companies c ON c.company_id = sr.company_id WHERE GROUP BY sr.company_id ) salary_companies

SELECT COALESCE(ROUND(AVG(sr.base_salary)), 0) AS overallAverageSalary, COALESCE(ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN sr.career_years <= 1 THEN sr.base_salary END)), 0) AS overallNewcomerAverageSalary, COUNT(*) AS totalRecordCount FROM salary_records sr JOIN companies c ON c.company_id = sr.company_id WHERE sr.status = '정상' AND c.approval_status = '승인' AND c.company_status = '정상'

SELECT DISTINCT c.industry_name FROM companies c JOIN salary_records sr ON sr.company_id = c.company_id AND sr.status = '정상' WHERE c.industry_name IS NOT NULL AND c.industry_name != '' AND c.approval_status = '승인' AND c.company_status = '정상' ORDER BY c.industry_name

SELECT DISTINCT c.company_size FROM companies c JOIN salary_records sr ON sr.company_id = c.company_id AND sr.status = '정상' WHERE c.company_size IS NOT NULL AND c.company_size != '' AND c.approval_status = '승인' AND c.company_status = '정상' ORDER BY c.company_size

SELECT c.company_id AS companyId, c.company_name AS companyName, c.industry_name AS industryName, c.company_size AS companySize, c.address_line1 AS addressLine1, c.logo_url AS logoUrl, ROUND(AVG(sr.base_salary)) AS averageSalary, ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN sr.career_years <= 1 THEN sr.base_salary END)) AS newcomerAverageSalary, ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN sr.career_years BETWEEN 4 AND 5 THEN sr.base_salary END)) AS middleCareerAverageSalary, COUNT(*) AS recordCount, MAX(sr.updated_at) AS latestUpdatedAt FROM companies c JOIN salary_records sr ON sr.company_id = c.company_id WHERE c.company_id = #{companyId} AND c.approval_status = '승인' AND c.company_status = '정상' AND sr.status = '정상' GROUP BY c.company_id, c.company_name, c.industry_name, c.company_size, c.address_line1, c.logo_url

SELECT CASE WHEN career_years <= 1 THEN '신입 · 1년 이하' WHEN career_years BETWEEN 2 AND 3 THEN '2~3년' WHEN career_years BETWEEN 4 AND 5 THEN '4~5년' WHEN career_years BETWEEN 6 AND 7 THEN '6~7년' ELSE '8년 이상' END AS careerLabel, ROUND(AVG(base_salary)) AS averageSalary, COUNT(*) AS recordCount FROM salary_records WHERE company_id = #{companyId} AND status = '정상' GROUP BY CASE WHEN career_years <= 1 THEN 1 WHEN career_years BETWEEN 2 AND 3 THEN 2 WHEN career_years BETWEEN 4 AND 5 THEN 3 WHEN career_years BETWEEN 6 AND 7 THEN 4 ELSE 5 END, CASE WHEN career_years <= 1 THEN '신입 · 1년 이하' WHEN career_years BETWEEN 2 AND 3 THEN '2~3년' WHEN career_years BETWEEN 4 AND 5 THEN '4~5년' WHEN career_years BETWEEN 6 AND 7 THEN '6~7년' ELSE '8년 이상' END ORDER BY MIN(career_years)

SELECT jc.job_category_id AS jobCategoryId, jc.category_name AS categoryName, ROUND(AVG(sr.base_salary)) AS averageSalary, ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN sr.career_years <= 1 THEN sr.base_salary END)) AS newcomerAverageSalary, COUNT(*) AS recordCount FROM salary_records sr JOIN job_categories jc ON jc.job_category_id = sr.job_category_id WHERE sr.company_id = #{companyId} AND sr.status = '정상' AND jc.is_active = TRUE GROUP BY jc.job_category_id, jc.category_name ORDER BY averageSalary DESC
SELECT company_id AS companyId, company_name AS companyName FROM companies WHERE approval_status = '승인' AND company_status = '정상' ORDER BY company_name
SELECT job_category_id AS jobCategoryId, category_name AS categoryName FROM job_categories WHERE is_active = TRUE AND depth = 2 ORDER BY display_order, category_name
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM companies WHERE company_id = #{companyId} AND approval_status = '승인' AND company_status = '정상'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO salary_records ( company_id, author_user_id, job_category_id, employment_status, employment_type, career_years, salary_year, base_salary, bonus_amount ) VALUES ( #{companyId}, #{authorUserId}, #{jobCategoryId}, #{employmentStatus}, #{employmentType}, #{careerYears}, #{salaryYear}, #{baseSalary}, #{bonusAmount} )
mapper.select: SELECT salary_record_id, company_id, author_user_id, job_category_id, employment_status, employment_type, career_years, salary_year, base_salary, bonus_amount FROM salary_records WHERE salary_record_id = #{salaryRecordId} AND author_user_id = #{userId} AND status != '삭제'
mapper.update: UPDATE salary_records SET company_id = #{companyId}, job_category_id = #{jobCategoryId}, employment_status = #{employmentStatus}, employment_type = #{employmentType}, career_years = #{careerYears}, salary_year = #{salaryYear}, base_salary = #{baseSalary}, bonus_amount = #{bonusAmount}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE salary_record_id = #{salaryRecordId} AND author_user_id = #{authorUserId} AND status != '삭제'
mapper.select: SELECT sr.salary_record_id, sr.company_id, sr.job_category_id, sr.employment_status, sr.employment_type, sr.career_years, sr.salary_year, sr.base_salary, sr.bonus_amount, sr.updated_at, c.company_name AS companyName, jc.category_name AS categoryName FROM salary_records sr JOIN companies c ON c.company_id = sr.company_id JOIN job_categories jc ON jc.job_category_id = sr.job_category_id WHERE sr.author_user_id = #{userId} AND sr.status != '삭제' ORDER BY sr.salary_year DESC, sr.updated_at DESC
